weekLabel.zh: 近期更新 · 10 月 29 日 – 11 月 2 日

title.zh: 发售前 17 天：GTA6 广告登上全球地标建筑，沃尔玛预购或送「神秘礼包」
title.en: 17 Days Out: GTA 6 Ads Take Over Landmark Buildings Worldwide, and Walmart Pre-Orders May Include a Mystery Bag

summary.zh: 国际宣传升级：官方图像与标志铺上多国建筑外墙、巨型 LED 屏与体育场馆。另有传闻称沃尔玛门店自提预购可获「surprise and delight bag」，11 月 12 日起领取——沃尔玛与 Rockstar 均未确认，且 11/12 只开放预载、不能提前玩。
summary.en: The international push escalates: official artwork and logos are up on building facades, giant LED screens and stadiums across several countries. A rumoured Walmart "surprise and delight bag" would ship from Nov 12 — unconfirmed by Walmart and Rockstar, and Nov 12 is preload only, not early access.

title.zh: 预购数据一览：估算 645 万份 / 6.3 亿美元，近三成美国玩家说要买——但官方仍未开口
title.en: GTA 6 Pre-Order Numbers: ~6.45M Copies and $630M Estimated, 29% of US Gamers Say They'll Buy — Still No Official Word

summary.zh: Sensor Tower 估算截至 10/20 数字版预购约 645 万份、6.3 亿美元（PS5 占 74%）；Circana 调查显示 29% 美国玩家计划购买，创其追踪史上最高。两项均非官方口径。下一个官方节点是 11/9 Take-Two 财报。
summary.en: Sensor Tower estimates 6.45M digital pre-orders worth ~$630M as of Oct 20, with PlayStation at 74%. Circana puts purchase intent at 29% of US players, its highest ever. Neither is official. The next checkpoint is Take-Two's results on Nov 9.

title.zh: 《Edge》探访 R 星北方工作室：12 张新截图与 90 分钟无脚本试玩，警察会记住你的衣服
title.en: Edge Visits Rockstar North: 12 New Screenshots, a 90-Minute Unscripted Demo, and Police Who Remember Your Outfit

summary.zh: Rob Nelson 无脚本试玩 90 分钟：警方会记录服装、武器、车辆与监控曝光；犯罪档案从 Professional 到 Irredeemable；Jason 与 Lucia 关系为四级量表。12 张全新截图含首次公开的水下锤头鲨。
summary.en: Rob Nelson played unscripted for 90 minutes: police log your clothes, weapon, vehicle and camera exposure; a Criminal Profile runs from Professional to Irredeemable; Jason and Lucia's bond is a four-point scale. Twelve new screenshots include the first proper underwater hammerhead.

title.zh: R 星美术总监回应「会不会缩水」：我们在珠穆朗玛峰上建了一座金字塔
title.en: Rockstar's Art Director on Whether GTA 6 Was Cut Down: "We've Built a Pyramid on Everest"

summary.zh: Aaron Garbut 表示团队在规模、细节、互动性、剧情与开放世界上都没有妥协，全作约 60 万条独特动画，并有一支只为背景路人写作的团队。同场 Nelson 称游戏「已经准备好了」。PC 版仍无消息。
summary.en: Aaron Garbut says the studio did not compromise on scale, detail, interactivity, story or open world, citing ~600,000 unique animations and a team writing solely for background NPCs. Nelson says the game is "ready". Still no word on PC.

title.zh: 《南方公园》播出官方 GTA6 实机片段：狗屎袋可以当武器，还能互抡
title.en: South Park Aired Official GTA 6 Gameplay: You Can Swing a Bag of Dog Poo at People

summary.zh: 第 29 季第 4 集插入约 17–20 秒实机画面，片尾署名由 Rockstar 提供。片段显示海滩支持高密度会反应的 NPC 人群，环境物件可捡起当临时近战武器，被攻击者会还手。发售日与定价不变。
summary.en: Season 29 episode 4 carried roughly 17–20 seconds of gameplay, credited in the end titles to Rockstar. It shows beaches supporting dense, reactive NPC crowds and environmental objects usable as improvised melee weapons, with victims fighting back. Date and pricing unchanged.

title.zh: GTA6 最后 22 天日历：从 11 月 5 日财报到 11 月 19 日解锁，一个不漏
title.en: GTA 6 Final Countdown Calendar: Every Date Left Before the November 19 Unlock

summary.zh: 发售前日程已排满：11/5 索尼财报、11/9 Take-Two 财报、11/12 预载开放、11/18 热火「罪恶都市之夜」与传闻中的评测解禁、11/19 午夜解锁、11/20 预购特典截止。
summary.en: The run-in is fully booked: Sony's results Nov 5, Take-Two's Nov 9, preload Nov 12, the Heat's Vice City night plus the rumoured review embargo Nov 18, the midnight unlock Nov 19, and the pre-order bonus deadline Nov 20.

title.zh: 消息称 R 星已向媒体发放 GTA6 评测码，11 月 18 日解禁——玩家只剩一天看评分
title.en: GTA 6 Review Codes Are Reportedly Out With a November 18 Embargo

summary.zh: NateTheHate 称 Rockstar 已开始发放评测码、解禁定在 11 月 18 日发售前一天，Insider Gaming 表示独立验证。Rockstar 与 Take-Two 均未确认，也没有媒体公开承认持码。
summary.en: NateTheHate says review code is out with a Nov 18 embargo, one day before launch, and Insider Gaming says it verified the date. Neither Rockstar nor Take-Two has confirmed it and no outlet has admitted holding a copy.

title.zh: GTA6 容量曝光：PS5 版据报约 210GB，11 月 12 日开放预载
title.en: GTA 6 Download Size Reported at ~210GB on PS5, Preload Opens November 12

summary.zh: PS 商店后台读数报出 PS5 版 210GB，Kotaku 等跟进转述；Xbox 商店仍是占位值，Rockstar 与索尼均未官宣。210GB 在 100Mbps 下约需 4.7 小时，Series S 用户压力最大。
summary.en: A PS Store backend reading puts the PS5 install at 210GB, picked up by Kotaku; the Xbox store still shows a placeholder and Rockstar has announced nothing. 210GB is ~4.7 hours at 100Mbps, with Series S owners squeezed hardest.
